fullContentHtml:
Bihar BPSC 70th Final Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Final Result for the recruitment of 2027 Post 70th Combined Competitive Examination and other examinations 2024. BPSC recently, on 13 December 2024, conducted the Preliminary Examination for the aforesaid posts and now, for the help of participants, BPSC has uploaded the Pre Result. Now, BPSC has announced the Interview Date. The interview was conducted on 21 December 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Bihar BPSC 70th Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 28 September 2024
  • Application Start Date : 04 November 2024
  • Last Date : 04 November 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 November 2024
  • Correction Date : 19 October 2024 to 04 November 2024
  • Exam Date : 13 December 2024
  • Admit Card Available : 06 December 2024
  • Exam Date (Only Bapu Pariksha Parisar, Patna) : 04 January 2025
  • Answer Key Available : 08 January 2025
  • Pre Final Answer Key: 17 January 2025
  • OMR Sheet Date: 19-21 January 2025
  • Mains Exam Form
  • Start Date : 21 February 2025
  • Last Date : 17 March 2025
  • Mains Exam Date : 25, 26, 28, 29 & 30 April 2025
  • Mains Admit Card : 12 April 2025
  • Mains Result : 16 December 2025
  • DV Date : 29 December 2025 to 17 January 2026
  • Interview Schedule : 21 January 2026
  • Interview Letter : 15 January 2026
  • Final Result : 20 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC/ Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 150/-
  • Female Candidate (Bihar Dom.) : Rs. 150/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
